page.layout: One page: a single ruled table, in two blocks of 15 rows and a short third block. Columns from left to right: Indictiones, An. Iul., Lit. dom., Nabon., Feriæ, a column of September dates beside the Feriæ, and Christi. at the right. Running head at top; page number at top left. Nothing printed below the table.

main_text.l: Indictiones | An. Iul. | Lit. dom. | Nabon. | Feriæ | | Christi.

page.notes: The "4" before 1367 is a small italic reference mark, not a year digit. The dots near the 1 Oct. and 30 Sept. entries and the stray dot at the left of the first block rule are printer's marks and are not transcribed. The Christi. numerals are in old-style form and are copied as printed. The final row (Indictio 3, 1380) has no lunar, letter or feria entries, so those cells are left empty.
